note: TemplateSuggester's rule: cue hits per type, normalised to per-hundred-words, plus a speaker-count nudge on one_on_one (speakers==2: +1.0; speakers>=4: -1.0). Winner is the highest score at or above THRESHOLD=1.5, else 'general'. A tie keeps whichever type was checked first, which is table order (standup, one_on_one, client, interview, lecture, site_walk) — general is never a scored winner, only the fallback. `remembered`, when not null, wins outright before any scoring runs — it is what a person chose for an earlier meeting sharing a tag, read by AudioDb.rememberedTemplate. Read by TemplateSuggesterTest.kt.
